I am not 100% sure what you are looking for but if I understand correctly you want the camera to always be "above" the ship so that the player only sees the top, and when the player dies the ship rotates and appears to be sinking but it just rotates to show more of the background.

If we are both talking about more or less the same thing, my suggestion would be to make a sky-box for the background, and at the same time make your camera a child of your ship in your scene hierarchy. Then when the player dies you should actually rotate the ship, this will transform the camera at the same rate and show more of the background as it flips.

Again this is all assuming I understood your question correctly lol. If you have more questions or I misunderstood what you were looking for I would be more than happy to help.
